note: Independently frozen acceptance holdouts. These rows were compiled from the cited sources, not from gênio research output or a model-generated song list.

methodology.independence: Expected tracks were transcribed from the cited public sources before staging evaluation. Runtime research output must never be used to amend expected results.

paulinho_da_costa.classification: evidence-backed sample; not a complete career catalogue
paulinho_da_costa.scope: Released recordings explicitly associated with Paulinho da Costa at track level by his official biography or by an individual Discografia Brasileira track musician section.
paulinho_da_costa.inclusionRule: The source must name the recording and Paulinho da Costa; Discografia Brasileira rows must list him as Percussão inside that exact track's Músicos section.
paulinho_da_costa.exclusions: Album-only credits, whole-album expansion, inferred assignments, rows whose source says musicians were not specified by track, Discogs, and the prior ChatGPT conversation.
paulinho_da_costa.coverageLimit: The 56 rows intentionally sample nine independently inspected source pages. They do not prove recovery of all 6,000-plus reported credits. A complete independent lifetime holdout remains blocked by unavailable or non-track-specific liner notes.

michael_jackson.classification: complete within the frozen adult Epic/MJJ album scope
michael_jackson.scope: The 80 unique original studio recordings on Off the Wall (1979), Thriller (1982), Bad (1987), Dangerous (1991), HIStory disc 2 (1995), the five non-remix songs opening Blood on the Dance Floor (1997), and Invincible (2001), as enumerated by the Michael Jackson Estate and Sony/Epic Legacy sources.
michael_jackson.inclusionRule: One row for each original track in the seven enumerated album containers; the five Blood on the Dance Floor studio songs are included and its eight remixes are excluded.
michael_jackson.exclusions: Motown-era solo albums, Jackson 5/Jacksons recordings, guest appearances, standalone singles, demos, alternate languages, remixes, live recordings, compilations, and posthumous albums.
michael_jackson.coverageLimit: This is a complete, testable album-scope holdout, not a claim to contain every released Michael Jackson performance across labels, groups, singles, guests, versions, or posthumous releases.
